messages:
Mike (Sales): Heads-up — handing off Stellara (Enterprise). Contract signed yesterday. Quick context: private GCP deployment, Okta SSO, reserved capacity request (2x p50), billing starts Mon. Renewal term 12mo, renewal trigger ~11mo out. Legal flagged data residency in eu-west1. Feature ask: embeddings quality for product search (they tested and saw drift).

Sara (CS): Thanks — looping in. Can you paste the signed SOW and which models/quant profiles they expect? Also did sales agree to weekly enablement calls for first 90 days? :spiral_calendar:

Mike (Sales): SOW link: https://go.redwood/sow/stellara-213. Models: `open-large-v2` (prod), fallback `open-medium-q4`. They wanted quantization guidance but no hard requirement yet. Yes — weekly 30m enablement for 12 weeks.

Ashley (Support): Noted. Any known integrations beyond Okta? Webhooks? DB access? We should create initial support runbook.

Mike (Sales): They have an internal analytics pipeline hitting embeddings via our API and a webhook to their ingestion service. No DB access needed.

Sara (CS): I will own the enablement cadence. Next steps for me: 1) create onboarding checklist, 2) schedule first enablement call (this week), 3) open triage tickets for infra & SSO. Assigning owners below.

Sara (CS): Triage tickets I created: `TKT-4321` (private deploy network/peering), `TKT-4322` (Okta SSO setup), `TKT-4323` (capacity config + autoscale policy). Links: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/TKT-4321

Jon (Eng): I'll pick up `TKT-4321` and `TKT-4323`. Quick note on capacity: suggest starting with reserved pool = 2 GPUs with burst to 4 for 1hr/day; we can tune after 2 weeks of telemetry. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching for their product-search workload.

Ashley (Support): I'll own `TKT-4322` for SSO. Need their Okta admin contact and test SP metadata. Sara — can you collect?

Sara (CS): @Ashley yes — I'll grab contact info on the kickoff call. Also capturing open risks: 1) embeddings drift — schedule eval with ML to reproduce; 2) data residency — legal wants processing in eu-west1 only (private deploy can satisfy but needs confirmation of region and KMS).

Mike (Sales): Legal contact: priya.legal@stellara.com. They want HSM/KMS integration.

Jon (Eng): For eu-west1 private deploy we need a short checklist: region infra availability, KMS integration steps, and backup policy. I'll spin a doc: `deploy/stellara-eu-checklist.md` (internal) and post link once created.

Sara (CS): Owners & next steps summary (I'll track in the customer record): - Enablement owner: Sara (CS) — schedule weekly 30m - Infra ticket (TKT-4321): Jon (Eng) — network + region + backups - Capacity ticket (TKT-4323): Jon (Eng) — reserved pool + autoscale - SSO ticket (TKT-4322): Ashley (Support) — Okta setup - ML eval: assign to R&D triage, cc Jon — reproduce embeddings drift within 5 working days - Billing/start date verification: Mike (Sales)

OnboardBot: Reminder created: onboarding-playbook -> Stellara, first enablement call due in 72h.

Ashley (Support): Acked. I'll open a test tenant and request SP metadata after kickoff.

Mike (Sales): Anything blocking from my side? I can push the Okta admin contact and legal SOW details tonight.

Sara (CS): No blockers. Please add Priya (legal) and their infra lead (marc@stellara.com) to the kickoff invite. I'll post meeting notes and owners after the call. :white_check_mark:

Jon (Eng): Will prioritize tickets and post ETA by EOD tomorrow.

Sara (CS): Closing loop — I'll update the customer health to 'onboarding: in progress' and set renewal watch = 'yellow' due to embeddings concern + data residency ask. We'll reassess after two weeks of telemetry.

Mike (Sales): Thanks team — appreciate quick responses.
